source_text: Type III FGM/C (infibulation), prevalent among immigrants from countries like Somalia and Sudan, causes extensive scarring that obstructs vaginal delivery, elevating cesarean delivery odds by approximately 55% according to systematic reviews of obstetric outcomes applicable to affected U.S. populations.
